name: Cheesy Broccoli-Bacon Soup with Bell Pepper, Cucumber & Arugula Salad
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

When the bacon is done, add broth, Alfredo sauce, broccoli, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until broccoli is tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the soup is cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Add arugula and dressing to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
Divide soup between bowls and top with cheese; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
